title: Public counters — /stats.json
description:
The public counter artifact, with an explicit three-state machine so that a number's ABSENCE is a documented state rather than a bug (WEB-060/061, FS-10 §10).

`state` is computed from real registry and ledger facts and is never set by hand:
  · `pre-launch` — mechanism copy only. Every numeric field is null. No letter-of-intent counts, no progress bar.
  · `launched-pre-disbursement` — projects, contributors and companies are real; `chfRoutedMinor` stays NULL with `firstDisbursementScheduledFor` naming the date. 'CHF 0' is never rendered, neither as an achievement nor as an embarrassment.
  · `post-first-franc` — every figure is real and `chfRoutedMinor` is the ledger total.

A field may be null in any state where the underlying thing does not yet exist: at P-M2 `contributorsClaimed` is null because there is no claim flow to claim through, and the page labels it as the structural zero it is (VS-19). *(Amended 2026-10-24, 1.3.0: `contributorsClaimed` now counts the distinct contributors the Purpose Points snapshots credit, from 5, and is null wherever nothing is measured, the count is below that floor, or a record's count below 5 could be worked out from it; see the member.)*

Rendering rules travel with the data: a `computedAt` caption, deep links to the source surfaces, no upward animation from zero, and `prefers-reduced-motion` honoured (WEB-062/063, WEB-121).

generatedAt.description: Rendered as the `computedAt` caption. A counter without its timestamp is a claim without a date.

source.description: Which plane produced this artifact. `sample` and `fixture` declare a NON-PRODUCTION plane: every page that renders such an artifact is labelled sample, and a production deployment refuses to serve it (FS-10 §2 v0 note; the edge route answers `sandbox_artifact_on_prod`). `registry-v0` is the P-M2 production source of record — the curated registry repository the index is built from. `platform` is the P-M3 producer of record — the platform database, rendered by `jobs.index-build`. Optional, and its absence asserts nothing: an artifact whose body cannot carry the label borrows the plane's declaration from `/registry/index/meta.json`. The enum widens additively when the P-M3 producer takes a value of its own, and `platform` (2026-09-12) is that widening: `jobs.index-build` writes it in `PSN_ENV=prod` and writes `fixture` in every other environment, so a reader can still tell a production plane from a synthetic one by the label alone. Two catalogued artifacts deliberately have no such member and are the borrowers above: `badge.v1` (shields.io owns the body — a foreign field would break the endpoint contract) and `certificate-policy.v1` (a rule, byte-identical on every plane, so a plane label on it would be meaningless). No signed payload carries it either: the label is a property of the build, not of what was attested.

state.description: The machine state. The prose labels S1/S2/S3 stay prose and never appear in this artifact (FS01-050).

projectsRegistered.description: Registered repositories in ops decision D82 item 1's sense: every repository registered from the moment it passes the network's registration rules, whether or not its admins have claimed it, until it quits or is delisted — in the platform's internal states `detected`, `verified` and `suspended`. On the same plane it is the index meta's `totals.registered` + `totals.suspended`. *(Worded 2026-09-30, D82 item 1; the member had no description.)*

contributorsClaimed.description: The distinct contributors credited with a share above zero by the Purpose Points snapshots of one month, each person once however many repositories credit them (FS-10 FS10-080, the dated note of 2026-10-24; the member's name predates that meaning, and no contributor claim exists). The month is the newest LOCKED month in which a repository's chosen snapshot is complete, and `contributorsAttribution` names it with the algorithm and its provisional label. Published only when both of these hold, and null otherwise: (1) it is at least 5 (ops decision D121 item 1's floor for contributor figures); and (2) no repository counted in the month is below that floor, or the people whom only such repositories credit number at least 5 and fewer than 4 times those repositories. A repository is counted when its chosen snapshot of the month is complete, and it is below the floor when that snapshot credits fewer than 5, so its record carries no `contributorCount`. Condition (2) is `designations-summary.v1`'s condition (2) read for people, and it keeps the floor whole: without it, subtracting the records' published `contributorCount`s from this count could show a repository's count below 5, and at 4 times those repositories it would show each of them crediting exactly 4. It is null as well whenever a repository counted in the month has no record on the same plane showing that month, so the records whose `attribution.month` is the basis's `month` are exactly the repositories counted, and condition (2) is judged over what a reader can subtract. Wherever nothing is measured it is null too, and in `pre-launch` every counter is null. A contributor whose identity record an erasure deleted can no longer be told apart from another, and is not counted. *(Changed 1.3.0, 2026-10-24, pre-release. As first published: "Null until the claim flow exists — an honest structural zero, labelled as such on the page (VS-19)." Every document a real plane published before 1.3.0 carries null.)*

contributorsAttribution.description: The Purpose Points basis of `contributorsClaimed` (FS-06 FS06-020: a field derived from a PP-v0 snapshot carries its algorithm and its provisional label as data, so no page can show the count without the label). Present exactly when `contributorsClaimed` is a number on a real plane, and refused beside a null one. *(Added 1.3.0, 2026-10-24, pre-release.)*

algoVersion.description: The algorithm the counted month's snapshots were computed under.

provisional.description: The provisional label as data (FS06-020): `true` for a count of PP-v0 snapshots (a corrected PP-v0 version under FS06-072, such as `PP-v0-r2`, included), and a document that says otherwise is refused.

algorithmNotesUrl.description: The published algorithm notes (FS06-016, FS06-018, FS06-021).

chfRoutedMinor.description: Ledger total in minor units. NULL, never 0, before the first disbursement.

cur.description: Reporting currency for `chfRoutedMinor` (CHF; the final ruling is URS §21 OPEN-26).

firstDisbursementScheduledFor.description: Set in `launched-pre-disbursement` so the empty money figure has a date attached instead of a shrug.

loi.description: Letter-of-intent counts. Stays NULL unless the escrow-visibility decision resolves to public (URS §21 OPEN-17, default: silent); then it carries counts from real signed letters only.

detectedUnclaimed.description: Deprecated: not published from ops decision D82 on, and a producer omits it (it was never required). No public artifact counts repositories whose admins have not claimed them, because whether admins have claimed is their internal matter (D82 item 3, dated note (c) of 2026-09-29); a detected repository is registered and counted in `projectsRegistered`. Kept so a document published before D82 stays valid (versioning policy 4). *(As first published: "Repositories detected but never claimed. Aggregate only — detected repositories are never listed (GH-014).")*

smallnessThresholds.description: Below these counts the page states the number in words with context rather than as a headline figure — small numbers are told, not dressed up (WEB-061).

links.description: Deep links to the surfaces each counter comes from. A counter that cannot be traced to its source surface is not published (WEB-062).

allOf.$comment: WEB-061 S1: in pre-launch every numeric field is null. Enforced structurally so a build cannot ship a pre-launch page with a number on it. OPEN CONFLICT FOR A HUMAN TO SETTLE: the illustrative artifact in FS-10 §10 (FS10-080) shows these fields as 0 while pre-launch, whereas VS-19 states them as null and the honesty law forbids rendering 'CHF 0' either as achievement or as embarrassment. This schema implements VS-19; if the FS-10 example is meant literally, this rule is what must change, and it must change here first. See CHANGELOG.md.
WEB-061 S2: money stays null and the first-disbursement date must be named.
WEB-061 S3: post-first-franc, the money figure is real.

1.3.0 (FS06-020; D121 item 1): the counter's basis stands only beside a count, and a count beside its basis is never below the floor of 5. In pre-launch the counter is null (allOf[0]), so the basis is absent there too. A count without a basis is not refused here, because a sample plane's count predates the basis and is no Purpose Points figure (allOf[4] refuses it on the planes that measure). The counter's condition (2) and its rule that every counted repository has its record (`contributorsClaimed`'s description) span the plane's documents, so the renderer holds them, not this schema.

1.3.0 (FS06-020): on a plane labelled `platform` or `fixture`, whose count is a Purpose Points figure, a count stands only beside its basis, so no page can show it without its algorithm and its label. A `sample` plane's count is fictional and carries none, a `registry-v0` plane's is null, and a document without `source` asserts no plane (the member), so none of those is refused here.
